verses.translation: [SEED] You have a right to action alone, never to its fruits; let not the fruits of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
verses.translation_source: MVP placeholder — replace with licensed text.

verses.translation: [SEED] One should lift oneself by oneself; do not degrade oneself — for the self is one's own friend and one's own enemy.
verses.translation_source: MVP placeholder — replace with licensed text.

verses.transliteration: [SEED] sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: [SEED] Abandon all varieties of religion and simply surrender unto me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions; do not fear.
